description.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women's rights organisations that have received support from CMI members, Including measuring the # of CSOs with increased L&A capacities and strengthened holistic security approaches.

comment.narrative: This indicator measures the number of women's rights organisations that have received support from CMI members.

In 2024, CMI! supported a wide variety of WROs across Asia to strengthen their L&A capacities and their holistic security. These organizations worked with many different groups, including but not limited to LBTQI+ persons, women and girls with disabilities, women refugees, women and girls in the informal entertainment sector, and young feminists. They advanced feminist demands related to sexual health and reproductive rights and justice, economic empowerment, LBQTI+ rights, and bodily autonomy. Thanks to this support, WROs were able to continue advancing feminist demands in key decision-making spaces at different levels, promoting the rights of women and gender-diverse groups as well as strengthening their organizational security systems through the adoption of new digital, psychosocial, physical, and environmental measures.

In 2025, CMI! supported a wide variety of WROs across Asia working to ending gender-based violence and on promoting economic justice. The WROs' main constituencies have included sex workers, LBTQI people, young feminists, rural women, and women from structurally excluded groups. Through this support, WROs strengthened their L&A capacities and their holistic security, which in turn helped them to create powerful advocacy groups, partnerships and alliances, provide access to resources to their constituencies, monitor the implementation of state's gender equality and human rights commitments, and create essential platforms where marginalized and often overlooked gender-diverse voices can share their perspectives, needs, and concerns in national, regional and international spaces. Their digital, physical, psychosocial and environmental security systems and practices were also reinforced during this period.

This indicator is also unique, as the number of WROs supported by CMI members will be reported only once. If different support is provided to the same WROs, they will be counted once, and details will be provided in the comment box.

Through CMI!, Mama Cash provides Women’s Rights Organisations (WROS) with core funding to build resilient organisations. Core funding is flexible support to WROs to adapt strategically and work sustainably in contexts with high levels of discrimination, political repression and conflict sensitivity.

This indicator is also unique, as the number of WROs supported by CMI members will be reported only once. If different support is provided to the same WROs, they will be counted once, and details will be provided in the comment box.
